literal_meaning: বস্তু বা পটল তুলে নেওয়া (to pick up a bundle or package)
figurative_meaning_en: to pack up and leave; to be ruined or fail
example_sentences_in_bangla: প্রকল্পটি শুরু হওয়ার কিছুদিন পরেই পটল তুলে ফেলল।
example_sentences_in_english: His shop's business has packed up.
The project folded just a few days after starting.
history: This idiom originates from the traditional practice of Bengali merchants or traders who would bundle their goods in a 'patol' (cloth bundle) and leave a place when their business failed or trade was unprofitable.
note: Commonly used in contexts of economic setback or discontinuation of activities.
